title: Unit – 4 : Session – 11 : SLO – 2  |  Converting a TCP Client to UDP
sections: I. Key Changes (TCP client → UDP client)
2. No connection setup: remove connect() — UDP is connectionless.
3. Sending: send()/sendall() → sendto(data, (host, port)) — every datagram carries its destination.
4. Receiving: recv() → recvfrom(bufsize) — returns (data, address) because the sender must be identified.
5. No listen()/accept() on the peer; a UDP "server" just bind()s and calls recvfrom().
6. Error handling: no automatic retransmission — timeouts and retries must be implemented by the application.
